notes: Restaurant's own site (catamaranresort.com/oceana-coastal-kitchen, part of the Catamaran Resort Hotel) shows only hours and a single Monday-night promo, no priced menu. Used SinglePlatform's restaurant-submitted full menu (tier 4, medium confidence per source ladder) since it is the only source with complete pricing across all dayparts. Cross-checked breakfast pricing against a second directory (sagemenu.com): overlapping items mostly matched exactly (Steel Cut Oatmeal $15, Buttermilk Pancakes $19, Belgian Waffle $19, Lox & Bagel $22, Perricone Farms Juice $7) with a few items showing different names/descriptions and prices $1-2 apart (Avocado Toast, Breakfast Burrito, Cinnamon Brioche French Toast), consistent with normal seasonal menu rotation rather than a stale/marked-up source - no clean markup ratio present. Captured every section SinglePlatform listed: Breakfast (+ add-ons, beverages), Lunch (Starters, Sushi & Cold Bar, Flatbreads, Salads & Bowls, Sandwiches, Plates), Dinner (Start & Share, Cold Bar, Sushi Rolls, Plates), Dessert, Kids (Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner), Weekend Brunch (Start, Early, Later, Beverages), Craft Cocktails, Barrel Aged, Zero-Proof, Beer (Cans, Draft), Seltzers & Canned Cocktails, and Wine (Bubbles through Cabernet Sauvignon). Protein/egg add-ons to salads (+chicken $10, +salmon $15, etc.) are noted in descriptions rather than as separate dishes. Wine and cocktail items sold by both glass and bottle are split into separate line items.
